prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1252; do not mention it.)
text:
Please be advised that this office now represents our client in connection with the collision that occurred while she was turning left at an intersection and was struck by another vehicle. She has sustained injuries as a result of this incident and is undergoing ongoing medical care.

Effective immediately, all communication regarding this matter, including requests for statements, recorded interviews, or settlement discussions, must be directed exclusively to this office. Our client should not be contacted directly by you or any representative acting on behalf of your insured.

We request that you provide a complete copy of the declarations page for the applicable policy, along with confirmation of all bodily injury and property damage liability limits that apply to this loss, including any excess or umbrella coverage of which you are aware.

We also ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, vehicle data, telematics or dashcam footage, claim file notes, adjuster recordings, witness information, and any repair or salvage records. Please confirm in writing that these materials will be retained and not altered or discarded.
